title: an empty items array is worth flagging

spec.name: JSON Feed
spec.normative_quote: items (required, array) is an array where each item represents an individual piece of content in the feed. JSON Feed 1.1 does not forbid an empty items array.
spec.note: conformance_testable is false: the spec allows an empty items array outright. This id is our own local operational judgment that a feed with no items at all is noteworthy, not a spec violation -- matching the severity: warn already on disk.

applicability: A parsed feed.json document whose "items" array is present and empty.
